value.quotedAs: Certificate of high/secondary school leaving examination

evidence.quote: A complete application consists of the following documents:
- Copy / copies of high/secondary school leaving examination or university degree / degrees AND its translation (in English),
- Transcript of Records and its translations in English
- Copy of the valid passport (with the place and date of expiration),
- Letter of motivation in English (Presentation of previous studies and courses.

notes: The tuition fee EUR 3,000 per semester is listed under 'Programmes & Fees 2024/25' on the university's international tuition page and applies to Vehicle Engineering BSc (7 semesters); it is the fee for self-financed (fee-paying) international students. A separate deadline page states 'The deadline for the application for the first year of the course is 30 July at the latest.' but that sentence is attached to the 'NEW PROGRAMME! MECHANICAL ENGINEERING BSc' note and does not name the non-EU applicant, so no intake/deadline fact was extracted. The requirement of a high/secondary school leaving examination is quoted as 'Successful completion of an ISCED level 3 or 4 programme', which in Morocco normally means 12 years of prior study; the page does not state a year count literally, so prior_study_years_min=12 is an interpretation the auditor should verify.
